title_en: Table 6.8 : REGISTERED THALASSAEMIA CASES IN MALE' AND ATOLLS, 2005 - 2014
notes: Maldivian Blood Services was formed in December 2012 after Merging National Thalassaemia Centre (NTC) and National Blood Transfusion Services (NBTS)
Maldivian Blood Services is the parental body of Thalassaemia and Other Heamoglobinopathies Centre (TOHC) and Central Blood Bank (CBB)
Thalassaemia and Other Heamoglobinopathies Centre was formed under Thalassaemia Control Act ( 4 / 2012 ) which was retified by President on 10 May 2012
By law a new register had to be formed and maintained from 10 May 2012 onwards
